title: Drive to Recycle Saturday - Irvine
desc: City of Irvine community recycling event. Bring recyclable materials for a chance to win cash and prizes for IUSD schools.
location: Irvine, CA (check City of Irvine website for exact location)
body: High-energy, family-friendly event. The community collects and brings recyclable materials. Prizes benefit Irvine Unified School District schools.

title: OCWR Free Community Compost Giveaway
desc: Free compost distribution for Orange County residents in celebration of Earth Day.
location: Orange County (check oclandfills.com for exact location)
body: Free compost available for OC residents. Hosted by OC Waste & Recycling in partnership with community organizations.

title: Huntington Beach Cleanup with Veterans!
desc: Open to anyone. Join veterans and volunteers for a 2.5 hour community cleanup on Huntington Beach.
location: 405 Pacific Coast Hwy, Huntington Beach, CA 92648
body: Doors open at 6:45 AM, cleanup from 9:00 to 11:30 AM. Gloves and bags provided. Optional 21+ veteran social afterward.
